blurb: Amit Kukreja is a New York-based financial content creator and entrepreneur who publishes under the handle @amitisinvesting across X, YouTube (approximately 117,000 subscribers), and Substack. A Rutgers Business School graduate, he transitioned from finance to digital media around 2021, building a following focused on growth-stock analysis — particularly technology companies and AI plays such as Palantir. He hosts the Basis Points podcast, has made angel investments in private companies, and previously founded Audea, an AI-powered search engine for spoken-word audio. His congressional-trading posts, which parse freshly filed Periodic Transaction Reports, are among his most widely shared content.
credibility_note: Kukreja presents himself as a financial educator and market commentator rather than a licensed investment adviser. His congressional-trading posts aggregate public disclosure data rather than offering original analytical claims; the underlying PTR filings are verifiable through the House Clerk's public database. His technology-sector commentary reflects a bullish growth-stock orientation.
